Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are Bertrandt : an independent, international development service provider with long years of automotive expertise. We create technological solutions for our customers at any stage of the product development process with a focus on hot topics such as digitalization, e-mobility and autonomous systems, largely for the automotive, aerospace and mechanical engineering sectors.
 Our goal: accelerating technological progress. We work on this every day – with around 13,000 employees at over 50 sites worldwide.
 What to expect: 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Python
Create, execute, and maintain automated test cases for functional and regression testing
Develop and enhance automation frameworks using PyTest and Robot Framework
Analyze test results, identify defects, and support root cause analysis
Collaborate closely with development and QA teams to improve product quality
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Monitor, maintain, and optimize automated test execution
Prepare and maintain test documentation and reports
Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and automation practices
 What you bring along: 
Proven experience in test automation using Python and PyTest
Hands-on experience with Robot Framework
Experience working with CI/CD environments
Good knowledge of Jenkins for automated build and test execution
Experience with version control systems such as Git
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Proactive approach to problem-solving
Continuous learning attitude
Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment
 What we offer: 
Flexible work environment
Private health insurance with optional medical packages for you and your family.
24 vacation days, increasing to 25 days after 3+ years with us.
Meal tickets and Holiday vouchers.
Bookster and 7Card subscription.
 *Our offices are located in Bucharest, Sibiu, and Cluj-Napoca
